description: Build the Phaser 4 Advantage Play Kit (APK), keep advantage-games as its development and QC testbed, preserve the established game I/O contracts, support Primary and Secondary editions, prove package consumption across host apps, and establish the existing-game rebuild program.
deviation_notes: Successor to archived Wave 3 game import-readiness work and the cancelled app-local Babel Architect Phaser and R3F rendering experiments. This track preserves the established vocabulary-array, sentence-array, and game-result ABI while intentionally preserving mechanic concepts rather than legacy renderer behavior or source compatibility.

sprint.goal: Establish the Phaser 4 Advantage Play Kit as the canonical game platform, with advantage-games as its live QC testbed, stable learning I/O contracts, dual Primary and Secondary editions, representative cartridges, and proven package consumption by host applications.
sprint.demo_notes: Product-owner QC approved all three representative cartridges in Primary Chibi and Secondary Epic on 2026-07-10. Automated evidence: contracts 40/40, runtime 17/17, cartridges 23/23, both host smokes 2/2, QC Jest 1/1, Playwright Chromium 3/3, and Advantage Games production build green.
